sentences.text:
Rajeev Kumar @ Rajiv Gupta vs State Of Haryana And Others on
14 July, 2023
 119 2023:
In The High Court Of Punjab And Haryana

Date of Decision: July 14, 2023
 Rajeev Kumar @ Rajiv Gupta ........ Appella
 Versus
 State Of Haryana And Others .......Respondent
 Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Harkesh Manuja
 Present: Mr. Ashok Kumar Verma, Advocate for appellant.

By way of present appeal, challenge has been laid to an award dated 13.03.2023 passed by the Reference Court-cum-Addl. District Judge, Sirsa, whereby reference petition filed under section 30 of Land Acquisition Act, 1894 seeking apportionment of compensation, at the instance of appellant has been partly allowed.
2. Learned counsel for the appellant on instructions submits that the appellant does not wish to press the present appeal.
3. In view of the above, the present appeal is dismissed as withdrawn.
